scope: RWKV7 native-BF16 token-shift plus six-way mix6 Triton fusion for single-sequence and decode-batch paths.

accuracy.operator: operator_accuracy.json; exact max_abs_error=0.0 for T=1/8/257/1024 with no cache, [hidden] cache, and [tokens, hidden] batch cache
accuracy.service: candidate_serial_ids.json and candidate_serial_ids_repeat.json; 3 repeated serial runs matched retained token IDs for 8 prompts x 32 tokens

workload: 8 fixed prompts, concurrency=8, 32 output tokens, five measured rounds after one warmup; --enforce-eager --mamba-cache-mode align
conclusion: Rejected and reverted: native BF16 fusion passed exact operator and serial token parity, but real service throughput regressed 3.98% (additional run -4.17%). The isolated kernel gain did not survive the full RWKV7 decode pipeline.
